response.positive: at least one sequence with genus exactly Sus and species exactly scrofa at that deployment in that ISO week
response.negative: active deployment-week with no such sequence
response.interpretation: recorded detection/non-detection under camera effort, not biological presence/absence

baseline_features.categorical_encoding: one-hot levels frozen from all deployment-only registry rows; no response-derived level filtering
baseline_features.missing_policy: STOP if any required baseline value is unavailable for an eligible unit

layer_a.state_before_week_t: uses focal-positive source deployments observed only in weeks strictly earlier than t
layer_a.local_world_compatibility_update: after week t, retain a local world iff every focal-positive deployment newly observed in week t is within that world's frozen threshold of at least one previously accumulated focal-positive source deployment; when no prior source exists, initialize sources without pruning
layer_a.source_accumulation: union of all focal-positive deployments through completed weeks

layer_b.for_each_week: compute before seeing that week's response from accumulated prior positive sources and current surviving world set
layer_b.no_source_state: constant no-source summary derived only from current surviving world count and external-open support
layer_b.predictive_signature_gate: apply existing v2 saturated-static-identity gate before fitting augmented arm; if blocked, terminal structural-only STOP, not predictive evidence

inner_selection.fit: fit baseline and augmented on inner_train only
inner_selection.score: macro over inner-validation ISO weeks of binary log loss; within validation, contextual state may update only after each scored week using that completed week's response; learners do not refit
inner_selection.promotion_rule: promote augmented iff augmented macro log loss is strictly less than baseline macro log loss

outer_evaluation.refit: after selection, fit both baseline and always-augmented diagnostic models on inner_train plus inner_validation; selected policy uses the frozen selected arm
outer_evaluation.sequential_context: outer week contextual representation may assimilate responses from earlier completed outer weeks only after those weeks are scored; no learner refit during outer
outer_evaluation.primary_score: macro over outer ISO weeks of binary log loss

terminal_classification.promoted_outer_favorable: inner selector promotes augmented and augmented outer macro log loss < baseline outer macro log loss
terminal_classification.promoted_outer_adverse: inner selector promotes augmented and augmented outer macro log loss > baseline outer macro log loss
terminal_classification.promoted_outer_tie: inner selector promotes augmented and outer macro losses equal
terminal_classification.baseline_retained_protective: inner selector retains baseline and always-augmented outer macro log loss >= baseline outer macro log loss
terminal_classification.baseline_retained_missed_benefit: inner selector retains baseline but always-augmented outer macro log loss < baseline outer macro log loss

hard_boundaries: No target, split, threshold, feature, learner, promotion rule, estimability minimum or terminal definition may change after response access.
No second response run or outer-score rerun is allowed.
A response-schema or estimability STOP is not predictive evidence.
This fresh selective-promotion validation does not reopen or alter the closed three-endpoint EOG-WF synthesis.
